outcome: Obstetrical complications (cesarean delivery, history of miscarriage, preeclampsia)
cohort: 223 women with gestational diabetes mellitus out of 2136 deliveries at a level III maternity in French Guiana, with 110 followed up for 6 months
finding: Despite a high prevalence of GDM (10.3%) in a socially deprived population, universal screening and monitoring helped limit the risk of macrosomia.
